## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For a new page, explain its idea.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant checks pass; release changes pass lint, build, and typecheck.
- [ ] Visual changes were inspected at desktop and phone widths.
- [ ] Changed interactions were checked with keyboard and reduced motion.
- [ ] Affected comments and docs are current.

Include evidence relevant to the change. Mark irrelevant checks as not applicable.
